images.reasonSelected: This ground-level site photograph showcases a fully paved, smooth asphalt internal road complete with kerbstones, landscaped borders, and street lighting columns. It provides undeniable visual proof of development readiness and quality, instantly validating our 'fully developed infrastructure' claim for high-end residential buyers.

This drawing represents the master layout view of the 10-acre plotted colony. It shows individual plot boundaries, numbering, arterial roads, and the entrance gate placement, helping the buyer visualize the community scale and structured organization.
